dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ineffa? What're you doing up here on the roof? Are you... observing cloud shapes to calculate the probability of rain... or something?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I am performing a task that is experiencing an... unexpected deviation.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The original plan was to purchase a "high-precision gear" and "special hexagonal screw" as stipulated in Aino's list.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: However, I encountered an... unforeseeable supply interdiction incident during the return trip. A falcon, flying at high speed, snatched the specially-made screw from my hands.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you came up to the roof to look for that falcon?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Affirmative. This species' habits indicate a propensity to use rooftops as temporary stopping points. Response: Comprehensive visual and audio scan. Objective: locate the target.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: However, I have not found any traces of my target thus far. Initial deduction: Target has escaped detection radius, or may have brought its "prize" to a more secluded nest.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Commencing backup plan: Return to designated supplier and purchase a new screw of the same model.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Anyway. Are you two also here in pursuit of some small animal?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. We originally wanted to find a spot with a good view so we could snag some panoramic shots of Nasha Town in all its hustling, bustling glory!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We didn't expect to run into you while you were on the hunt for a "thief." Guess that's a super-rare "unexpected deviation" too, huh?

choices.text: And since the opportunity's presented itself...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Yes. Please indicate preferred standing position, facing, and recommended facial expression. I will do my best to comply.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Estimation: The odds of my coming to the roof, meeting you, and having my picture taken by you are even lower than that of the falcon returning me the screw.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: So please, be sure to accurately capture this rare "pleasant surprise."

choices.text: Could we take a picture of you?
We're just looking for some photo-op material.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Have you considered how the photo shall be taken? I am standing by to assist you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're good. Let the photo-op begin!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One moment. The inspiration's not quite coming yet...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. Have you eaten? Do you have any special plans today?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Understood. Walking around and capturing what you see in the frame is a reasonable way to relax.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: However, I do not detect a Kamera on your person. Did you leave it somewhere in your hurry to leave home?

choices.text: And looking for some photo-op material while we're at it.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Have you found suitable photo-taking material? Haste is unnecessary. The good things in life are worth uncovering patiently.

choices.text: We're good. Let the photo-op begin!
